goal: Make peer-to-peer message handling easier to navigate and review for maintainers
Break up a monolithic thousand-line processing routine into dedicated message handlers
agreement: Strong support across reviewers for better code navigation and encapsulation
Verified as a pure code move using diff tools and test coverage (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds, l0rinc)
Concept approval for improving diff context and navigation (stickies-v, theStack, maflcko, pablomartin4btc)
Resolved concern that separate helpers add caller ambiguity compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is purely an internal cleanup that improves readability and code navigation
It fixes no bugs, adds no features, and does not alter protocol behavior or denial-of-service bounds
